legal_name: Automotive Component Manufacturers Association of India (ACMA)

note: ACMA is not a manufacturer or trader — it is the national industry association / apex body representing Indian auto-component manufacturers (self-description on acma.in: 'an organization representing manufacturers in the Indian auto component industry'; ISO 9001:2015 certified body; Director General Vinnie Mehta; President Sriram Viji). It is a Section 8-type non-profit industry association, so it does not export goods itself and HS 870899 is not applicable to it as a supplier — the declared HS belongs to its member companies, not to ACMA. Role therefore recorded as service_provider (industry association), not manufacturer/trader.
